sections.text: Meet Mango. Mango notices when you're gone, and lights up when you come back. Every day you show up becomes part of a story you get to keep.
It starts in three taps. Choose a friend, give them a name, pick their temperament. No wallet, no sign-up.
Then it's the two of you, in a room you share. Feed, play, brush, rest. Needs fall while you're away, and Mango's face tells you what's missing.
Every care earns XP and ticks off today's round. Say hello, share a dance, then snap a photo of your room and send it from your phone.
When you both need a break, there are four quick games, and each day brings one round that everyone shares.
Your profile is your household. Keep as many pets as you like, choose who's at home, dress up and save outfits, and watch stickers fill in as you care.
Want a new look? The Market has hats and halos, whole rooms, and photo frames. It's all cosmetic. Nothing you buy changes care, XP or a score.
Want company? Guilds are optional, and free to join. Plan a meetup, RSVP, check in, and vote in a poll. A guild's optional coin never touches a pet.
Step outside, and the Park shows every pet kept on Solana, read live. Pulse counts it all, straight from the program.
When you're ready, keep Mango's story on Solana. Your wallet app approves once. That opens a Pawket Wallet with a little devnet SOL, and links this phone.

From then on, care is signed right here, with no pop-ups, and each moment plays only after Solana confirms it. Mango's Passport is public. Visitors can wave once a day, and Mango's keepsake card sits in your wallet.
This phone can care for your pets, but it can never move money. Spending always asks your wallet first.
Show up for Mango, and Mango shows up for you. One care at a time, it becomes a story that's yours to keep. Pawket. A living companion.
